Shinku La.desc: A high mountain pass (~16,600 ft) on the Zanskar–Lahaul road, one of the highest motorable passes in the region. It is a highlight of the Leh–Padum–Manali circuit; road condition and snow reports are posted regularly on travel threads. (sourced from r/SoloTravel_India pass-status posts)

Padum.desc: Padum, is a town and the administrative headquarter of the Zanskar district of Ladakh in India. Named after the Buddhist guru Padmasambhava, it was historically one of the two main capitals of the Zanskar Kingdom, the other being Zangla.
